tools.name: flood_zones_lookup
tools.description: FREE, no API key. Checks which of 9 open Québec flood-zone sources (BDZI, flood-zone presence grid, the historical 2017-2019 ZIS, Gatineau, Québec, Sherbrooke, Montréal) intersect a point. Give exactly one of: lat+lon, address (Québec civic address, matched to the Référentiel québécois des adresses)

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "v1" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: acte_get, plan_get, watch_create, platform_billing_get · Private data: flood_zones_lookup, lot_resolve, lot_get, registre_index_request, acte_get, plan_get, job_get, job_results, document_get, document_entries, batch_submit, watch_create, billing_get, billing_usage, platform_billing_get · Public sink: registre_index_request, acte_get, plan_get, batch_submit, watch_create.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: acte_get, plan_get, watch_create, platform_billing_get · Private data: flood_zones_lookup, lot_resolve, lot_get, registre_index_request, acte_get, plan_get, job_get, job_results, document_get, document_entries, batch_submit, watch_create, billing_get, billing_usage, platform_billing_get · Public sink: registre_index_request, acte_get, plan_get, batch_submit, watch_create

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
